title: Account Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Account Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

As an Account Manager for Brazil , you'll join our passionate and supportive team characterised by our ambition and team spirit. You'll have the freedom to work independently while fostering strong collaboration with our content and product departments.


You'll be responsible for driving the entire sales and success cycle in the iGaming market, from initial engagement to maximizing long-term results. Managing key client relationships, driving sales growth, and ensuring customer satisfaction within these specific regions. This role requires a proactive approach to identifying opportunities, understanding client needs, and delivering tailored solutions that drive mutual success.


Specifically, your role will involve:


  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, including sports betting operators, casinos, online gaming platforms, and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for key client accounts, managing all aspects of the client relationship and serving as their trusted advisor.
  • Understand clients' business objectives, market trends, and regulatory requirements specific to the English speaking markets to effectively position our gambling products and services.
  • Collaborate with internal sales, marketing, and product development teams to customize solutions and address client needs within these regions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for upselling additional products/services and expanding client accounts.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling sales presentations, proposals, and business cases to key clients within these regions.
  • Monitor and analyze sales performance, market trends, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and optimization within key accounts.
  • Attend industry events, conferences, and trade shows worldwide to network with key clients and stay informed about industry insights and developments.
  • Provide timely and accurate reports on key account performance, sales activity, and revenue forecasts within these regions to management.
  • Stay up-to-date on gambling regulations, compliance standards, and responsible gaming practices to ensure adherence and mitigate risks.


The ideal profile


We're on the lookout for someone who not only shares our values and ambitions but also envisions growing alongside MoveUp Media. As a dedicated team player, you embody fair play, transparency, agility, and an unstoppable drive. You're the perfect fit for our team if you:


  • Have outstanding written and verbal communication skills in Brazilian Portuguese and English.
  • Understand gambling products, platforms, and regulations in specific regions.
  • Drive change and support accounts in the iGaming industry with your sales skills.
  • Be ambitious, adaptable, and thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Focus on exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth.
  • Bring experience in iGaming strategy, sales, or affiliate management.
  • Excel in building and maintaining strong relationships with partners.
  • Possess excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Show active listening, resilience, and persistence.
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving abilities and effective task coordination.
  • Excel in time management, organization, and planning.
  • Manage multiple accounts and tasks simultaneously.
  • Use analytical skills and a data-driven mindset for decision-making.
  • Thrive in teamwork and adapt well to evolving environments.
  • Be open to occasional travel for client meetings and industry events.


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • First Interview: A conversation with your future manager to ensure you meet the role’s requirements.
  • Second Interview: A chat with HR to understand you better and ensure a cultural fit with MoveUp Media.
  • Final Step: A proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • Remote Work Environment: Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely full-time.
  • Flexible Schedule: We measure results , not hours, and offer paid time off.
  • Development Opportunities: As a rapidly growing startup, we offer numerous possibilities for career advancement and support your career path.
  • Team Gatherings: Annual team get-togethers to connect, work, and have fun . We strive to find enjoyable spots for everyone.
  • Wellness Fund: €1,000 per year dedicated to your professional development, sports, or cultural events of your choice.


MoveUp Media

title: Almoxarife
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Almoxarife em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Atender às reservas e requisições de materiais, separando e entregando conforme necessidade das áreas internas.
  • Receber materiais conferindo AR (Autorização de Recebimento) e condições físicas dos produtos.
  • Armazenar os materiais em locais apropriados, respeitando critérios de segurança, validade e acessibilidade.
  • Realizar contagens cíclicas e apoiar na execução de inventários físicos.
  • Controlar prazos de validade e integridade dos materiais durante o armazenamento.
  • Apoiar na organização e limpeza do almoxarifado, conforme padrões de 5S.
  • Lançar movimentações básicas no sistema ERP, com apoio ou sob orientação do Almoxarife II ou do líder.
  • Comunicar divergências ou anomalias nos materiais ou processos ao superior imediato.
  • Apoiar em outras atividades do setor sempre que necessário.
  • Realizar descargas, e movimentações dentro do almoxarifado com o uso de empilhadeira.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas às descritas acima, compatível com a sua condição pessoal e conforme solicitado pelo seu superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio Completo.
  • Habilitação em Empilhadeira (NR 11).
  • Carteira de Habilitação B.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Experiência atuando em almoxarifado.
  • Vivência no pacote office, principalmente Excel;
  • Conhecimento em procedimentos de recebimento, conferência e controle de estoque, em sistema ERP (movimentações, baixas, requisições) e em inventário físico e contagem cíclica.


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses).


The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.


The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.


Financial


● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.

● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.

● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates

● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.

● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients

● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients

● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions


Operational


● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.

● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.

● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.

● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.


Experience and Skills


● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.

● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance

● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.

● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.

● Knowledge of ERP systems, NetSuite a plus

● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.

● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Marketing AI Agent Builder em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works

  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips

  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan

  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks

  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms

  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)

  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)

Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack

  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Intelligence Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Company


Fraud Deflect helps businesses make better decisions around fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance. We work with high-volume operational data and need clear, trusted reporting that helps teams move quickly and make better decisions.



About the Role


We are looking for a BI Analyst to own and improve business reporting across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, merchant performance, and operations. This role is focused on dashboards, KPI tracking, reporting consistency, metric definitions, and turning business questions into clear, actionable insights.

You will work closely with leadership, operations, product, and engineering to make data easier to understand, easier to trust, and more useful in day-to-day decision-making.

  • Own dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking across core business areas
  • Build and maintain reporting that gives teams clear visibility into fraud, chargebacks, disputes, alerts, and operational performance
  • Write and optimize SQL for reporting, analysis, and data validation
  • Define, document, and improve business metrics so teams are working from consistent numbers
  • Analyze trends, anomalies, and performance changes across key datasets
  • Partner with stakeholders to translate business questions into practical reporting and analysis
  • Improve the usability, accuracy, and trustworthiness of existing reports and dashboards
  • Identify reporting gaps, data inconsistencies, and metric definition issues
  • Create clear visualizations and present findings in a business-friendly way
  • Support self-service reporting and help teams use data more effectively


Requirements

  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and recurring business reporting
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate ambiguous business questions into clear metrics, reporting, and analysis
  • Experience working with production data and validating reporting accuracy
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience defining and maintaining KPIs or business metrics
  • Comfortable working in a remote environment
  • Able to pass a background check


Preferred

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, risk, or other operational data
  • Experience with BI and visualization tools
  • Experience working with large datasets in a business reporting environment
  • Experience with AWS-based data environments
  • Basic Python skills for ad hoc analysis or validation
  • Experience with ClickHouse or similar analytical databases
  • Familiarity with data warehouse or reporting-layer concepts


How to Apply

Please send your resume in English.

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto.   • Minimum B2 level in English (written and spoken), and Portuguese ;

  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid setting based in Lisbon or Porto.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;

  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;

title: Coordenador de Banco de Dados
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador de Banco de Dados em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.

Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área:

  • Lidar com diversos fornecedores de produtos e serviços que atendem a disciplina de Banco de Dados acompanhando, gerindo e cobrando ações quando necessário.
  • Interagir com as áreas pares para entender e endereçar demandas, novos projetos, problemas, duvidas e reclamações a respeito do ambiente de Bando de Dados.
  • Cuidar para que o ambiente se mantenha atualizado e com as ultimas features de segurança.
  • Assegurar o uso otimizado dos recursos tecnológicos da plataforma através da análise das métricas de capacidade dos bancos de dados;
  • Planejar, elaborar e executar projetos de infraestrutura de Banco de Dados liderando equipes heterogêneas afim de otimizar e maximizar a performance de cada indivíduo além de atender as novas demandas das áreas de negócio;
  • Implantar recursos de bancos de dados para capacitar o ambiente a suportar crescimentos e demandas de negócio mesmo que ainda não mapeadas;
  • Apoiar, instruir e direcionar o time técnico afim de sanar dúvidas, questões técnicas ou processuais a respeito da disciplina de Banco de Dados;
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão e vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas;


Principais atividades:

  • Supervisionar e acompanhar a disciplina de Banco de Dados, participando de projetos e crises, contribuindo e orientando os seus liderados na forma de atuar e ser um facilitador nas interfaces com as outras disciplinas tanto de Operações, Engenharia de Infraestrutura e Engenharia de Desenvolvimento.
  • Acompanhar, validar e medir a qualidade e saúde do ambiente de Banco de Dados.
  • Estruturar e acompanhar os indicadores da area de Banco de Dados .
  • Tracionar iniciativas de automação para a gestão do ambiente de Banco de Dados, reduzindo atividades operacionais e garantindo agilidade e tempo de resposta as mudanças de ambiente.
  • Contribuir para obter um clima organizacional favorável, bem como a redução do turn over, através de ferramentas de gestão de pessoas, como contratações assertivas, comunicação interna eficaz, treinamento e desenvolvimento, reconhecimento e recompensa, buscando equipes de alta performance.
  • Zelar pelo sigilo das informações tratadas na sua área de atuação.
  • Cumprir as metas estabelecidas no Contrato de Gestão vigente, através da execução das ações previstas no plano de metas. Liderar um time de Banco de Dados com diversas stacks de Banco de Dados tanto onpremises quanto em Cloud.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

  • Experiencia em gestão de pessoas
  • Habilidade de construir matriz de decisão, RFPs e RFIs
  • Experiencia de gestão financeira e de contratos de infraestrutura de TI
  • Conhecimento Avançado de banco de dados SQL Server
  • Conhecimento de Bancos Nativos Cloud
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados My SQL (Desejável)
  • Conhecimento de banco de dados No SQL (Desejável)
  • Cursos e certificações correlatas a Banco de dados


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: Segunda a Sexta

Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Go Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Go Developer

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead


Important Information


Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts
  • Advanced English skills.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;
  • Interest in GenAI and LLM technologies.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

As a Senior Backend Engineer , you’ll be designing and architecting scalable solutions , creating robust APIs, and building new microservices from the ground up —while also improving and optimizing our existing systems. This isn’t just another engineering role. We’re solving real, painful inefficiencies in the insurance space – problems so frustrating that prospects have nearly teared up during sales calls, realizing how much time and effort we could save them. What we’re building isn’t just an upgrade – it’s a fundamental shift in how agencies operate .


What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and develop scalable TypeScript microservices powering XILO’s platform.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work where your strengths shine and contribute to:
  • AI Agents – Automating complex decision-making and workflows
  • OCR & Document Processing – Extracting, structuring, and analyzing key insights from insurance documents
  • Intelligent Data Mapping – Aggregating and linking all relevant data into a centralized, dynamic user profile
  • Advanced Insurance Operations & CRM – The AI-powered backbone of agencies, seamlessly tracking, managing, and integrating customer data across tools and workflows while replacing outdated, manual processes
  • Forms Builder & Smart Data Entry – A Typeform-like system built for insurance, enabling error-proof, collaborative submissions – fill once, apply everywhere
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, frontend, data science) to deliver seamless integrations.
  • Mentor and guide junior engineers, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented team culture.
  • Implement best practices for API security, data privacy, and maintainability.


What we’re looking for

  • 7+ years of backend development experience, with a strong foundation in TypeScript and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with Node.js
  • Proven expertise in designing and developing software product features, with a focus on scalability, performance, and maintainability.
  • Proven expertise in REST API design – including authentication, performance optimization, and security best practices.
  • Experience with XML and SOAP-based integrations, commonly used in the insurance industry.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Nest.js, leveraging its modular architecture for scalable backend services.
  • Familiarity with NX monorepos for structuring and maintaining large-scale applications.
  • Cloud deployment experience on Heroku and AWS, including CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure management.
  • Deep understanding of database management, ORM usage (e.g., TypeORM, Prisma, Sequelize), and zero-downtime migration strategies.
  • Experience designing and implementing microservices architectures, including inter-service communication, data consistency, and service decoupling.
  • Bonus: Full-stack experience with modern frontend frameworks like Angular.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).


What we offer

  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Why Join XILO?

  • A great tech startup – Small, fast-moving, and driven by real impact
  • Endless career growth – Help shape the team, tech, and company as we scale

title: Lead Full-Stack Developer (.Net+Angular)

The Mission

We are building the next generation of real-time solutions for our Risk Management and Portfolio Management teams. This isn’t just maintenance; you will be part of a small, elite agile squad of technologists tasked with re-engineering how we handle high-throughput, latency-sensitive financial data.

We value the \"Full Lifecycle Engineer\"—someone who takes pride in owning a feature from the initial whiteboard sketch and requirements gathering through to implementation, automated testing, and production monitoring.


Technical DNA

We are looking for a specialist in the .NET ecosystem who treats performance as a feature, not an afterthought. You should possess:

  • Architectural Mastery: A deep obsession with Clean Architecture , SOLID principles, and design patterns. You believe code should be as readable as it is fast.
  • Performance Engineering: Real-world experience building Low-Latency/High-Throughput systems. You know how to find bottlenecks using profiling tools and how to mitigate them.
  • The Concurrent Mindset: Expertise in TPL (Async/Await) and a deep understanding of thread safety and synchronization. You don't just use lock; you understand why you're using it.
  • Data at Scale: Mastery of SQL Server performance tuning, from execution plans to index optimization, ensuring our data layer scales with our ambitions.

The Toolkit (Must-Haves)

  • Core: C# / .NET 8 (or ASP.NET Core)
  • Patterns: Clean Architecture, DI/IoC (Autofac/Microsoft), Domain-Driven Design (DDD).
  • Data: SQL Server, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, and Query Tuning.
  • Infrastructure: Distributed Systems, Microservices, and Cloud-native design.
  • Reliability: Monitoring & Observability (App Insights/Prometheus), Memory Management (GC Tuning).
  • Operations: Full SDLC ownership, including CI/CD and Production Support.

What Makes You Stand Out

  • You have an independent mindset but crave a collaborative environment.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Salesforce Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).



Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.



Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;

title: Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Software Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Software Engineer


Technical Requirements

  • Expert level proficiency in React Native for building highperformance reusable components for both iOS and Android
  • State Management Mastery of Redux, MobX or React Context API for managing complex application states and offline data persistence
  • Experience writing Native Bridges JavaKotlin for Android Objective CSwift for iOS to access device specific features not covered by standard React Native APIs
  • Deep expertise in optimizing app render times, memory usage and battery consumption
  • Navigation Proficiency with React Navigation or React Native Navigation for complex screen flows
  • Mobile Ecosystem Tooling

  • Backend API Integration
  • REST GraphQL Deep understanding of consuming complex APIs handling authentication OAuth2JWT and managing data synchronization
  • Experience implementing offline capabilities using WatermelonDB Realm or SQLite to support field users with intermittent connectivity
  • Mobile DevOps Quality
  • CI/CD Pipelines Experience with Fastlane, Bitrise or Azure DevOps for automated mobile build and deployment pipelines
  • Testing Proficiency in Jest for unit testing and Detox or Appium for end-to-end E2E automation
  • Expert use of Firebase Crashlytics or Sentry to monitor app health and perform proactive bug fixing

  • Root Cause Analysis RCA Perform deepdive analysis on app crashes API timeouts or data inconsistencies implementing permanent architectural fixes

  • Experience with mobile security best practices biometrics certificate pinning

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

description:

We are looking for a full-time, remote Agentic Developer with 8+ years of experience in .NET, C#, Python, Node.js, or similar to join our client's Web / Foundations Team. In this role, you will contribute to the development and evolution of our client's core web platform, a mission-critical SaaS system that supports real-world customer workflows across healthcare, legal, education, and enterprise environments. You will play a key role in building and enhancing core product capabilities while ensuring reliability, scalability, and long-term maintainability.

In this context, agentic development refers to the structured use of AI

agents and LLM-powered workflows as part of the software development

As a senior individual contributor, you will take ownership of systems end-to-end, influence architectural decisions, and help modernize the platform to meet growing business needs. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, improve system performance, and elevate engineering standards. This is a high-impact position suited for engineers who think in systems, understand trade-offs, and can make sound technical decisions in a live, customer-facing environment.

Their goal is to break down language barriers worldwide via cutting-edge speech and language AI-powered solutions, such as video remote interpretation (VRI), over-the-phone interpretation (OPI), interpreter scheduling, simultaneous interpretation, and more.

Our client has remote teams across the U.S. as well as in Europe and the Philippines.   • Build and maintain backend APIs and service-to-service integrations
  • Contribute to modern web applications using Angular or comparable frontend frameworks
  • Improve system reliability, performance, observability, and maintainability
  • Help modernize legacy components while preserving stability in a live SaaS platform
  • Contribute to architectural decisions, technical standards, and engineering patterns

  • Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and technical problem-solving

  • 8+ years of experience in back-end development using C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or similar
  • Proven hands-on experience using agentic tools and development workflows in day-to-day software engineering
  • Experience building and maintaining SaaS platforms
  • Experience building modern web applications using Angular, React.js, or similar frameworks

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Artificial Intelligence Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Title: AI Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Long Term

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Overview


We are seeking an experienced AI Engineer to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Applied AI , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.
  • Define and measure impact using DORA and SPACE metrics , driving improvements across engineering workflows.
  • Build reusable patterns for:
  • AI-assisted code generation
  • Pull request automation
  • Test generation
  • Debugging workflows
  • Developer self-service enablement
  • Evaluate, prototype, and lead POCs for AI tools , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Manage AI usage governance, including:
  • Token budgeting and cost controls
  • Usage monitoring and reporting
  • PII redaction guardrails
  • Audit logging and responsible AI practices
  • Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting LLM pipelines , APIs, and AI integrations.
  • Integrate AI tooling into GitLab CI/CD, GitOps workflows, and developer platforms .
  • Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Developer Experience , or related engineering roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling in production or enterprise settings.
  • Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.
  • Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing AI/SaaS tools , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.
  • Practical daily usage of tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT , or similar.
  • Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.
  • Strong AWS experience, ideally including:
  • Bedrock
  • API Gateway
  • Managed AI/Cloud Services
  • Experience with Terraform, Helm, GitOps, and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab preferred).
  • Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.


Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience contributing to an AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence .
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • LLM Agents
  • RAG pipelines
  • Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, OpenSearch, etc.)
  • LangChain / LlamaIndex
  • Exposure to AI FinOps , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.
  • Knowledge of AI governance and security , including:
  • OWASP Top 10 for LLMs
  • Prompt injection risks
  • Model supply chain security
  • Responsible AI controls
  • Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Gerente de Technical Advisor (ArcGIS / GIS) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Gerente de Technical Advisor (GIS / ArcGIS)


Descrição da vaga


  • Gerenciar e responder pela gestão do atendimento, fortalecendo o engajamento com o negócio das indústrias foco, em sinergia com Soluções, Marketing e Comercial, através da utilização de melhores práticas de ferramentas, processos e gestão de pessoas visando o aumento da qualidade percebida pelo cliente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Elaborar, implantar e acompanhar a estratégia da área (planejamento, orçamento, cronograma e indicadores);
  • Participar da construção da estratégia de negócios dos clientes e da Diretoria;
  • Garantir o engajamento com a estratégia da Diretoria/Empresa, desdobrando todas as iniciativas com o time;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Promover sinergia entre as áreas de Soluções e demais Diretorias/Áreas de empresa;
  • Orientar as áreas de negócios em relação as melhores práticas;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria nos processos de vendas, desenvolvendo ações alinhadas com as necessidades dos processos das áreas de negócio;
  • Gestão do atendimento dos clientes garantindo o sucesso nos negócios utilizando nossos produtos e serviços
  • Atuar na elaboração e execução de um plano para a intensificação do uso das tecnologias adquiridas para alavancar seus processos de negócio;
  • Garantir que as demandas necessárias a estratégia de negócio do cliente, tenham os recursos e ações direcionadas conforme sua expectativa;
  • Garantir o atendimento especializado para contratos EA/EAP;
  • Trabalhar em sinergia com os Canais de Venda no desenvolvimento das contas e com a área de Suporte e Customer Success garantindo a satisfação dos clientes;
  • Acompanhar e oferecer visibilidade do andamento das entregas sob sua gestão;
  • Gestão de faturamento e custos;
  • Gestão da alocação dos profissionais conforme meta e políticas estabelecidas.
  • Elaborar, conferir e validar Relatórios Gerenciais para apoiar na tomada de decisões da empresa;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento de novos projetos, melhoria dos processos e das atividades compartilhadas ou interdependentes, identificando e aplicando boas práticas de mercado e realizando reuniões interdepartamentais;
  • Gerenciar atividades da área, estabelecendo cronogramas, indicadores de desempenho e orientando sobre a forma a se fazer cumprir as metas de produtividade dentro dos prazos estabelecidos e negociados, visando assegurar o cumprimento de todas as obrigações da empresa;
  • Negociar prazos para o fornecimento de informações pelas gerências, avaliar a qualidade destas e acompanhar o lançamento destes dados, visando assegurar a qualidade do relatório e sua entrega nos prazos estabelecidos;
  • Realizar a Gestão de Pessoas, acompanhar, avaliar e desenvolver o time;
  • Ser referência no exercício da nossa cultura, estar envolvido com nosso negócio, se interessar pelo desenvolvimento da sua área e da empresa como um todo
  • Realizar a gestão e controle orçamentário da área;
  • Realizar a gestão de Processos, adesão as Políticas de Qualidade e gestão de riscos e mudanças.

  • Graduado/Especializações.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em GIS (Geographic Information System), IT (Technology Information) em Estratégia de Empresas;
  • Conhecimentos em Planejamento Estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em análise de custos e orçamentos;
  • Gestão de Pessoas e Performance de Times;
  • Experiência com o ArcGIS;
  • Inglês Fluente/Avançado;
  • Análise e interpretação de dados.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Mestrado;
  • Certificações Doutorado/Pós-Doutorado;
